notes.title: Cmoar Cinema 5.5 version is live on Google Cardboard/Daydream!
notes.content:
Just a quick news :-)

I have managed to update Cmoar Cinema on Google Cardboard to the newest version! It is almost exactly the same version as on Steam!! :)

Here you can find a demo version:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Cmoar.CmoarVirtualCinema
and a full version:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Cmoar.CmoarVirtualCinemaPro


Quick Google Cardboard features summary:

 Daydream Support
 Dynamic Lighting effect
 4 beautiful realistic sceneries [3 NEW!]
 LAN PLEX support ( DLNA server) [NEW!]
 LAN shared media (UPnP/DLNA media servers) [NEW!]
 3D 180° & 360° movies with options (orientation/zoom/tilt) [NEW!]
 Seat change ability [NEW!]
 Embedded subtitles and audio track support [NEW!]
 New VR menu interface [NEW!]
 Support for 2D & 3D Movies (SBS/Over-Under)
 Watching Youtube videos (1080p 2D)
 Watching Youtube videos (1080p 3D)
 Add every video and directory to Favourites
 "Last-viewed” option
 Many subtitle encoding formats


From now on, you can have a feature-rich Cmoar Cinema in your pocket! :)

notes.title: Cmoar Cinema 5.5 version is live! The biggest update since 2016!
notes.content:
Hello movie fans!

Finally, I was able to make Cmoar Cinema update that you wanted so badly!

First of all, this is great news for you because I have managed to update the whole project, so from now on, it's going to be much easier to release smaller updates regularly :-)

In the newest update you can find:
- Added support of  local network PLEX ( DLNA server)!
- Added support for streaming of network shared media (UPnP/DLNA media servers)
- Added/Fixed support for  3D! 360 /180 movies  with options (orientation/zoom/tilt) 
- Added a lot more subtitle encodings
- Added  Disc (DVD) support  with navigation (accessed from LAN category)
- Fixed Youtube player
- Added support for playback and browsing from external HDD devices


And of course if you encounter any problems, please let me know in the steam community forum or directly at sboczek@10antshill.com

I hope from now on, you will be fully satisfied with Cmoar Cinema. Please let me know how you like this update by commenting here or by considering making a Steam review :-)

notes.title: v1.1 Update - Embedded Audio/Subtitles support and more!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today is the day we have updated our Cmoar VR Cinema after almost two weeks from launch. Thanks to your feedback we were able to fix most of the issues you have encountered and at the same time we added features you wanted to see. Thank you for your cooperation and here’s the list:

Added features:

Added embedded audio track selection
Added embedded subtitles
Added multiple subtitle language encoding support
Added the option to disable subtitles
Added an option to add folders to favourites
Added an option to view the last typed phrases on Youtube
Added seat change possibility to the Boat Show scenery
Added subtitle outline and improved subtitle quality
Added new settings for 180°/360° videos (rotation, distance, tilt)
Added the option to swap eyes
Added volume control

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25309760/43c1c6c72dc9da1f233c9fb0437d6f4b36c4e03e.png

Improved & fixed:

Improved quality of some icons (gradient problem)
Fixed a rare crash when the movie was about to end



Once again, we would like to thank everyone for their feedback. If you enjoy  our Cinema, please leave a comment and/or a review on Steam - it really keeps us motivated and determined to deliver more features in the future :)
